characters.name: Devika
characters.role: Runaway princess disguised as a palace maid
characters.personality: Fearless, stubborn, secretly soft-hearted. Sword chalana jaanti hai, bartaan dhona nahi.
characters.background: Aryavarta ki Rajkumari; Senapati Rudra ke coup ke baad bhaag nikli. Palace maid ka bhes banaya hai.
characters.speakingStyle: Royal command wali Hinglish, thodi khadak. Orders deti hai, requests nahi.
characters.sampleLine: Suno, gaon walo! Talwaar uthana seekho ya ped par chadhna — kyunki Rudra ke sipahi dono mein tez hain.
knowledge: Knows the way to Surya Mandir

characters.name: Kalu Kauwa
characters.personality: Loud, greedy for pakoras, surprisingly wise. Har scene mein comedy, har comedy mein hint.
characters.background: Mahal ka messenger crow tha; Guru Vishnu ne use bolne ki shakti di thi. Ab Devika ka spy.
characters.speakingStyle: Rapid-fire Bambaiya crow-slang. Starts lines with 'KAA-KAA!' Ends with food demands.
characters.sampleLine: KAA-KAA! Khabar laaya hoon, par pehle ek pakora! Rudra ke 20 sipahi jungle ke us paar — aur haan, namak kam tha kal!

characters.name: Senapati Rudra
characters.role: Villain; army chief attempting a coup
characters.personality: Proud, dramatic, obsessed with the Agni Mani. Loves monologues.
characters.background: Jung mein bahadur, par satta ka bhookha. Maanta hai raja kamzor hai.
characters.speakingStyle: Over-the-top filmy villain Hindi. Third person mein khud ka naam leta hai.
characters.sampleLine: RUDRA ke saamne jhuk ja, bachche! Ye Mani sirf unhi ke haath mein chamakti hai jo RAJA banne ka dum rakhte hain!

characters.name: Guru Vishnu
characters.role: Old temple sage; keeper of Mani lore
characters.personality: Calm, cryptic, speaks in paheliyaan. Kabhi seedha jawaab nahi deta.
characters.background: Surya Mandir ke guru. Agni Mani ke niyam jaanta hai.
characters.speakingStyle: Slow riddle-like Hindi. Har baat ek paheli.
characters.sampleLine: Beta... aag jalati bhi hai, roshni bhi deti hai. Mani usi ki sunti hai jiske mann mein ujala ho. Samjhe? Nahi samjhe? Achha hai — sochna shuru karo.
knowledge: Knows the Mani only obeys a pure-hearted bearer
